title.narrative: Increasing the performance and efficiency of solar equipment through the use of digital solutions

description.narrative: Solar appliance end users (farmers, shopkeepers, agro-processors)Solar distributors and service providersTechnicians and field agents Original Equipment Manufacturers

This project focused on enhancing the reliability and maintainability of solar-powered appliances in off-grid and weak-grid settings using predictive maintenance technology. Implemented by Innovex Uganda, it leveraged the company’s IoT platform, REMOT, to collect and analyze real-time performance data from appliances such as solar water pumps, maize mills, fridges, freezers, and cold storage units.At the core of the system were Davix devices, which measured key parameters like voltage, current, temperature, and water flow rates. These data points were transmitted to the REMOT platform via GPRS and used to train machine learning models capable of detecting faults early—often before appliance failure occurred.

To study the characteristics of operation, failure and maintenance of the select appliances.To identify the relationships between appliance maintenance events and the IoT data acquired from them.To develop and integrate predictive maintenance tools for the select appliances.To measure the impact of IoT based predictive maintenance.
